items.scope: Cumulative whole registered replay at final printed boundary
items.allowed_use: YES: use top-level strict cycles for S_CH/S_DH/R/I
items.caveat: Per-kernel cycles are separately retained in proof.kernels; summing cumulative snapshots double-counts.

items.scope: Last kernel execution interval because update_stats folds/resets after each print
items.allowed_use: YES only as last-kernel metric, or consume proof.kernels for all ordered kernels
items.caveat: Not whole-application total; metrics is a mixed-scope dictionary.

items.scope: Persistent per-stream cache_stats at last snapshot; all audited33 have stream0
items.allowed_use: YES for whole replay in current first8 single-stream set; differences are print-boundary intervals
items.caveat: HIT+HIT_RESERVED+MISS+SECTOR_MISS; exclude retry RESERVATION_FAIL and supplementary MSHR_HIT/WRITE_ALLOCATED. Not all request types.

items.unit: cache access/miss/pending-hit/retry events across all access types
items.scope: Cumulative all-stream sum across L2 subpartitions
items.allowed_use: YES typed cumulative totals, same design/input/F; pending_hits means HIT_RESERVED only
items.caveat: Temporary l2_stats.clear at print initializes an aggregate, not the live L2 caches. Reservation failures are retry attempts, not unique requests or wall cycles.

items.unit: 32B issued data-command atoms in fixed model
items.scope: Cumulative sum of20 controller counters from constructor to snapshot
items.allowed_use: YES cumulative, and print-boundary differences; read_atoms=n_rd+n_rd_L2_A
items.caveat: Includes L2 write-allocation reads, unlike GLOBAL_ACC_R only. Not a latency or an end-to-end real-GPU transfer count. n_ref is explicitly unavailable.

items.unit: blocked subpartition-admission events per L2-clock tick
items.scope: Cumulative gpu_stall_icnt2mem across replay; may increment40 times per tick
items.allowed_use: YES as typed backpressure-event count within design/F; never percentage of GPU critical-path cycles
items.caveat: Increment when subpartition full and ICNT has a waiting packet, not isolated DRAM scheduler queue-full time.

items.unit: failed allocation/merge attempts aggregated across SMs
items.scope: Persistent L1 cache fail stats, CH PaperBase namespace
items.allowed_use: YES within CH F comparisons where explicitly printed
items.caveat: Distinct from L2 MSHR; reason fields absent in strict are not zero. No CH/DH mechanism equivalence from matching names.

items.unit: retry/failure events by reason and stream
items.scope: Persistent counters, only positive reasons are printed
items.allowed_use: Conditional raw-sidecar analysis after scope/type review; absent strict field stays MISSING
items.caveat: A numeric-only metrics parser does not consume bracketed reason fields. Do not invent zero or infer occupancy/wait cycles.

items.field: DTC_L1 PIB admits/retires/full events; lower_created/issued/responses; tag_requests/conflicts/evictions; lower-credit acquired/released
items.unit: typed simulator events, summed across SMs
items.scope: Cumulative persistent frontend/service members until snapshot
items.allowed_use: YES within the same CH or DH architecture and F; declared additive subset only
items.caveat: PIB entries are logical completion bookkeeping, not L2 MSHR entries. Tag-bank service conflict is distinct from tag mapping eviction/capacity conflict. Retry and primary/nonexclusive stall categories must retain their source definitions.

items.allowed_use: YES as drain/conservation checks, not as activity or pressure totals
items.caveat: Terminal0 means drained, not no misses/queue pressure; never sum or difference gauges into work.

items.scope: Running peak; some aggregate via max across SMs rather than sum
items.allowed_use: YES as a peak diagnostic; no per-kernel subtraction
items.caveat: Nondecreasing peak differences do not produce per-kernel peaks; pib_peak is explicitly max in paper_frontend_stats::add.

items.unit: SM-cycle samples; entry/line×cycles; summed per-item cycles; item counts
items.scope: Cumulative across persistent finite-service state and SM aggregation
items.allowed_use: YES within DH F where finite_service1; preserve denominator/count and event class
items.caveat: No CH absent-as-zero. Integral/sample yields a defined mean occupancy, not outstanding DRAM requests; latency decomposition sums are not critical-path wall time.

items.unit: integer-truncated global core-cycle age of DRAM request until bank assignment
items.scope: Cumulative tot_mrq_latency/tot_mrq_num when printed; additionally gated by num_mfs>0
items.allowed_use: Diagnostic same-design/F request-population mean, not isolated total L2-to-DRAM latency
items.caveat: MRQ timestamp starts at dram_req construction; excludes service after bank assignment. Do not weight by DRAM atoms or difference means; request/atom denominators differ.

items.unit: integer-truncated core-cycle means over their distinct packet/response domains
items.scope: Conditionally printed; num_mfs and mf_total_lat fold every500000 current-kernel cycles and after cleanup print
items.allowed_use: NOT released as exact final whole-application means: sampling/fold boundary can exclude current tail and mix numerator/denominator windows
items.caveat: Current33 raw has0 decimal tokens;8 sources have no mean lines at all. No regex fix is justified for these data. Missing is not0.
